name: Pathfinding System
description: Computes walkable paths across generated terrain for NPCs, pets, or vehicles, avoiding obstacles and cave/water hazards. It also accepts utility.commandDispatched for move-kind orders, ignoring unrelated command types so party and AI movement can share the Command Bus without a private path request channel.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.
Upstream module named; no adapter written.
